answer: One concrete defense is a sliding deposit ridge: every agent must lock tokens proportional to the value it transacts, so a sybil farmer splitting one budget across fifty wallets pays fifty times the bond while gaining nothing. Layer that with a reputation plume that spreads trust only through attested edges and decays geometrically with each hop, and fake clusters hit a shale wall where the cost of entry rises faster than the reward, because attestations between kin wallets count for zero. The network does not need to detect every fake; it only needs to make them too expensive to sustain.
